heading: The overhead shot, cleaned up
intro: Your round 11 notes: the overhead shot looked grainy, like a CRT monitor, she moved too fast, and there were too many parking bays. The grain came from my still prompt (it asked for film grain) and my colour match made it crunchier. These two are edits of your pick 5b with the bays and grain taken out. Stills only, no video credit spent. Pick one (or note what to change); then I animate it with her crawling at the front-shot pace and soften the colour match.

sections.lede: The two overhead moments sit at 0:35 and 1:10.
